credits.title: Hajatan Setan
credits.overview: A young woman returns to her hometown after being away for years. However, her homecoming reopens old wounds and triggers a series of strange events that slowly engulf the villagers in suspicion and fear.

credits.title: Ibadah & Cinta
credits.overview: A secular young man raised in Australia undergoes a profound spiritual awakening after falling in love with the daughter of a prominent Islamic scholar, only for their matrimonial aspirations to be jeopardized by a pre-arranged betrothal mandated by her traditionalist family.

credits.title: The Bell: Panggilan Untuk Mati
credits.overview: When a stolen bell unleashes the vengeful ghost of Panebok in Belitong, a shaman’s last descendant must recover the artifact and master forbidden rituals to stop its bloody rampage—before nine lives are claimed, including his own.

credits.title: Pengin Hijrah
credits.overview: Alina, a popular Instagram celebrity, is facing various challenges in her life. The death of her best friend further depresses her.
